title: Describe magnetic field lines

hook.scenario: Bar magnet ke paas lohe (iron) ke filings thoda faasle par gira diye jayein toh wo apne aap ek sundar si pattern bana lete hain.
hook.question: Ye iron filings aise curve lines mein kyun arrange ho jate hain?

mental_model.intuition: Magnetic field lines ek invisible force ka naksha (map) hain, bilkul jaise wind lines hawa ke bahav ko dikhati hain.
mental_model.description: Magnet ke aas paas ek invisible ilaka hota hai jismein uski force feel hoti hai. Us force ka flow dikhane ke liye hum imaginary lines banate hain, jinhe magnetic field lines kehte hain. Ye lines magnet ke North pole se nikalti hain aur South pole mein entry leti hain.

prediction.question: Bar magnet ke bilkul beech (equator) par compass needle kis direction mein point karegi?
choices: Magnet ke parallel, N se S ki taraf
prediction.explains: Equator par field lines magnet ke surface ke parallel chalti hain, N se S ki taraf. Compass needle usi direction mein align hogi — na N ki taraf seedha, na S ki taraf seedha.

reflection.prompt: Agar compass ko North pole ke bahut paas rakhein vs bahut door rakhein, toh needle ka behaviour kaise alag hoga?
reflection.answer: Paas rakhne par needle strongly N se door point karegi (field strong hai, lines crowded hain). Door rakhne par needle weakly align hogi kyunki field weak hai (lines door-door hain).

diagram3d.caption: Bar magnet ki field lines N se nikalti hain aur S mein jaati hain — compass needle har jagah local field ke saath align hoti hai.

poster.caption: Field lines North pole se nikalkar South pole mein jaati hain. Jahan lines crowded hain wahan field strong hai.

explanation:
Magnetic field ek aisi quantity hai jismein direction aur magnitude dono hote hain (yaani vector quantity). Kisi bar magnet ke aaspas ke magnetic field ko samajhne ke liye hum imaginary lines ka sahara lete hain jinhein magnetic field lines kehte hain.

In lines ki kuch bahut important properties hoti hain. Pehli, bahar ki taraf yeh humesha North pole se start hoti hain aur South pole par merge hoti hain. Magnet ke andar inki direction South pole se North pole ki taraf hoti hai, jisse ye continuous closed curves banati hain.

Doosri sabse badi property yeh hai ki jahan par magnetic field lines paas paas (crowded) hoti hain, wahan magnetic force sabse strong hota hai, jaise poles ke paas. Jahan lines door-door hoti hain, wahan field weak hota hai.

Aur teesri important baat, do magnetic field lines kabhi bhi ek dusre ko cross (intersect) nahi karti. Socho agar wo cross karti, toh point of intersection par compass needle ko do alag directions dikhani padti, jo ki scientifically impossible hai.

key_points.title: Direction
key_points.detail: Emerges from North pole and merges at South pole outside the magnet.

key_points.title: No Intersection
key_points.detail: Two magnetic field lines never intersect each other. If they did, it would mean two directions of the magnetic field at one point, which is impossible.

worked_example.problem: State whether true or false: Magnetic field lines are open curves starting from the north pole and ending at infinity.

steps.narration: Magnetic field lines kabhi open nahi hoti, wo North se nikal kar South par jaati hain, aur magnet ke andar South se North wapas aati hain.
steps.math: North to South (outside) + South to North (inside)

steps.narration: Iska matlab wo continuous aur closed loops banati hain.

worked_example.answer: False. They are closed continuous curves.

worked_example.problem: Why don't two magnetic field lines intersect each other?

steps.narration: Ek point par magnetic field ki sirf ek hi net direction ho sakti hai (jahan compass ki needle point karegi).
Agar lines intersect karti hain, iska matlab intersection point par compass ko do directions point karni padengi, jo ki practically impossible hai.

worked_example.answer: If they intersected, the compass needle would point in two different directions at the point of intersection, which is impossible.

common_mistakes.title: Thinking field lines only exist outside the magnet
common_mistakes.explanation: Bache sirf North se South ka rasta yaad rakhte hain. Par magnet ke andar bhi lines travel karti hain South se North, tabhi loop close hota hai.

recall_questions.q: What is the direction of magnetic field lines inside a bar magnet?
recall_questions.answer: From South pole to North pole

recall_questions.q: What does the degree of closeness of magnetic field lines indicate?
recall_questions.answer: The relative strength of the magnetic field

recall_questions.q: In which direction do magnetic field lines emerge?
recall_questions.answer: From the North pole to the South pole outside the magnet.

oa_questions.question: List three properties of magnetic field lines.
oa_questions.answer: 1. They emerge from the North pole and merge at the South pole outside the magnet. 2. The degree of closeness indicates the strength of the magnetic field. 3. No two field lines ever intersect.
oa_questions.approach: State the standard properties clearly as given in the textbook.

oa_questions.question: What does the degree of closeness of magnetic field lines indicate?
oa_questions.answer: The relative strength of the magnetic field.
oa_questions.approach: Explain that denser lines mean stronger magnetic forces.
